config.expression: if(len({view.custom.picked}) = 0, 'Tick themes in the table to install or remove just those.', len({view.custom.picked}) + ' ticked')

config.script:
import themepack
	names = list(self.view.custom.picked)
	themepack.uninstall_some(names)
	themepack.remove_imported(names)
	self.view.custom.picked = []
	self.view.custom.tick += 1

row = self.props.data[event.row]
	# Only ours and imported themes can be acted on;
	# a tick on any other row would do nothing.
	if row['kind'] not in ('custom', 'imported'):
		return
	self.props.data[event.row].pick = not row['pick']
	self.view.custom.picked = [r['id'] for r in self.props.data if r['pick']]
